column5: F: How does a browser hold all this? | M: SQLite in WebAssembly, local first.
column6: F: How does one browser tab hold all this? | M: SQLite, compiled to WebAssembly, under three dot js. Local first... no server. | F: Even at this size? | M: Twenty two million vertices. We stopped storing what the browser can recompute... six hundred and sixty one megabytes became three hundred and ninety six. | F: And speed? | M: One check went from sixteen seconds to twenty two milliseconds.
